legal.privacy.languageModel.title: Language model and Claude API
legal.privacy.languageModel.body: Off by default. Only if a person chooses “Claude API (cloud)” under Settings › Language model and confirms it, text goes to Anthropic (api.anthropic.com, USA) with the organisation’s own API key: in this version only the fixed test text, when someone presses Test; with later features, text from meetings when a feature asks for it. With “Off” or “On this device” nothing is sent. The API key is kept only in the system keychain.
